register.title: Join your community
register.description: Choose how you'll help keep things working.
register.reporterSubtitle: Report and track issues at your site.
register.technicianSubtitle: Register independently. A site contract is optional.
register.adminSubtitle: Apply to manage a site — a super admin approves your request.

registerReporter.title: Create your reporter account
registerReporter.description: You'll be the person who files issues at your site.
registerReporter.siteIdHelp: Your site administrator will provide the site ID to use here. Contact them if you don't have it yet.
registerReporter.accountReadyBody: Sign in with the email and password you just chose.

registerTechnician.title: Create your technician account
registerTechnician.description: Register independently. A site contract is optional.
registerTechnician.independentNote: Start with no contracted sites. You can remain independent and arrange site contracts later.
registerTechnician.qualificationNotice: Registration creates an account; it does not verify your identity or qualifications. Before site work, arrange qualification, licence, insurance, and reference checks with the site administrator.
registerTechnician.accountReadyBody: Next: add your trade and specialty under Profile → Trade.

errors.accountCreatedButAutoSignInFailed: Your account was created, but automatic sign-in did not finish. Sign in with your new account.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

registerAdminApply.title: Apply to administer a site
registerAdminApply.description: A super administrator reviews your request before the admin role activates.
registerAdminApply.applyNotice: You will be able to sign in as a reporter immediately. Once approved, sign in again to activate admin access. Super admins perform identity and site-authority checks before approving — this form does not verify you.
registerAdminApply.submittedBody: Your account works as a reporter while a super administrator reviews your application. Track it under More → My admin application.

teamAccess.title: Team access
teamAccess.subtitleSuperAdmin: Create site-administrator, staff, and shop-manager accounts for approved team members.
teamAccess.subtitleAdmin: Create staff accounts for your site.
teamAccess.intro: Site administrators are appointed by a super administrator. Staff and site-admin accounts are tied to a specific site; shop managers are platform-level.
teamAccess.adminsOnlyDesc: This screen is reserved for site administrators and super administrators.
teamAccess.noSitesDesc: An accessible site is required before a team account can be created.
teamAccess.platformLevelNote: {role} accounts are platform-level and are not tied to a site.
teamAccess.passwordHint: Use a unique passphrase of at least {count} characters. This creates an account directly; email invitations and a mandatory first-login password reset are not available yet.
teamAccess.managedAccessFallback: Managed access is controlled by the backend.
teamAccess.dismissNote: You can also dismiss a confirmation and the next account can be created in the same session. The initial password should be changed on first sign-in.
teamAccess.confirmation: {role} account created for {name} ({email}), at {site}. This account can now sign in.

errors.chooseRole: Choose a role for the new account.

contracts.subtitle: Optional site relationships for technicians

contracts.requestBodyPrefix: Ask the site administrator to review your request. Share your technician account ID:
contracts.onlineUnavailableNote: Online requests and request tracking are not available yet. No request has been submitted from this page.

contracts.consentLabel: The technician has agreed to this site contract.

notifications.subtitle: Updates about your reports and assignments.
notifications.emptyDesc: Updates about your reports, assignments, and contracts will land here once the notifications service ships.
notifications.interimBody: Check the Reports tab for the latest activity. The Recent updates section on Home surfaces the most recent changes across your reports.

siteSetup.title: Site setup
siteSetup.intro: Add the labelled buildings and areas reporters pick from when filing a report, for example E5 / Classroom building.
siteSetup.adminOnlyDesc: Only the administrator of a site can manage its buildings and areas.
siteSetup.noSiteDesc: A site must be linked to your account before buildings can be set up.
siteSetup.readinessReadyDesc: {count} active building{plural} — reporters can file reports.
siteSetup.readinessSetupRequiredDesc: Add at least one building before reporters can file reports.
siteSetup.buildingRequired: A label and a name are required (e.g. E5, Classroom building).

siteSetup.helper: Buildings appear in the reporter's location picker as soon as they are added. The backend cannot know whether every real building has been entered — add each one your reporters need.
siteSetup.archiveConfirmBody: Reporters will no longer be able to select this building. Existing reports keep their location.

adminApplications.intro: Reporters who asked to administer a site. Verify the applicant and their authority over the site before approving — submitting the form is not verification.
adminApplications.superAdminOnlyDesc: Site-admin applications are reviewed by a super administrator.
adminApplications.nonePendingDesc: Site-admin applications filed through public signup appear here.
adminApplications.noticeApproved: Application approved. The applicant becomes a site administrator on their next sign-in.
adminApplications.noticeRejected: Application rejected. The applicant remains a reporter.
adminApplications.noticeAlreadyDecided: That application was already decided. The list was refreshed.

tradeProfile.intro: Add your trade after creating your account. These details are self-reported, not verified qualifications.

tradeProfile.reviewBody: Arrange a review with the site administrator covering your identity, relevant work history and references, qualifications, applicable trade licences and expiry dates, and insurance appropriate to the work. Requirements depend on the trade and location.
